label: molecules
quotes: Card
Card is a UI component module providing a reusable card presentational element, though no further details or requirements have been recorded yet.
Carousel
Carousel is a React component module providing a sliding/scrolling track UI, exporting a Carousel component for use elsewhere in the design system.
CaseItem
Documents the CaseItem module, a UI component with no recorded requirements yet.
Dialog
Dialog is a UI component module providing a modal dialog element that renders conditionally based on whether dialog content is present.
Field

Field is a molecule component that wraps an input or control with its associated label, state styling, and optional supporting content (such as help or error text) into a single reusable form field unit.
Footer
The Footer module provides the site-wide footer UI component rendered at the bottom of pages.
Grid
The Grid module has no recorded declarations beyond a single component named Grid, so only a minimal, non-speculative description can be given.
Lists
Lists module has no recorded declarations or requirements beyond a bare Lists.tsx file, so no confident high-level description of its purpose can be given.
Menu
The Menu module defines the application's Menu UI component, with no further implementation or requirement details recorded yet.
Metric
Metric module defines a component for displaying a metric, with no further details available from the sparse declaration data.
NavMobile
Renders the mobile navigation panel component used for the site's responsive nav UI.
Question
A React component module representing a Question, with no recorded requirements beyond its minimal declaration.
